learning_outcomes.text: Plan and design systems and services with the capacity to transport multimedia traffic in the field of Telematic Engineering.
Develop communication infrastructure deployment projects in corporate environments.
Evaluate energy efficiency in telematics infrastructures and services.
Plan, implement, and deploy software products.
Perform group work tasks for the design and development of projects related to Telematic Engineering.
Plan and design massive multimedia services to support requests from a large number of users.

assessment_rules: For ordinary evaluation, a minimum score of 5.0 out of 10 is required for the main project, continuous assessment, and theoretical exam. If all minimums are met and attendance is 50% for theoretical sessions and 70% for practical sessions, the final grade is calculated as (0.4 x Main Project) + (0.3 x Continuous Assessment) + (0.3 x Theoretical Exam). Otherwise, the grade will be the minimum of the calculated score and 4.0. For extraordinary evaluation, previous scores above the minimum are kept, otherwise new assignments must be submitted and a new theoretical exam taken. A minimum of 5.0 out of 10 is required in each part (theory, project, continuous assessment) to pass. If these minimums are met, the final grade is calculated using the same formula as the ordinary call; otherwise, the grade will be the minimum of the calculated score and 4.0. For differentiated evaluation, a minimum score of 5.0 out of 10 is required for continuous assessment and the theoretical exam, with the final grade calculated as (0.3 x Continuous Assessment) + (0.7 x Theoretical Exam); otherwise, the grade is the minimum of the calculated score and 4.0.
